method: Pooled spectral-only PCA. Three common electric channels; all three must have valid nonharmonic FWHM and contrast >=3; saturation excluded. Complete cases only: no validity flags or imputation in PCA. Three Ward groups in all 12 robust-scaled features; k=3 is a browsing choice, not a selected physical class count.
harmonics: 150,300,450,600,750 kHz; mask +/-2 Welch bins, grow to 3x local background up to +/-5 bins before peak reselection
resolution: 468.75 Hz Welch bin spacing. Unresolved widths retained as measured window-limited widths, explicitly flagged in channel catalog. No transfer-function correction.
not_in_fit: V4/V5 and SCM are measured and retained in the channel catalog but excluded from the common-channel pooled PCA to avoid conflating different configurations.
